'''Lechee''' was a [[Gran]] [[Gender|male]] [[Merchant|vendor]] who resided in the [[Vargo Spaceport]] on the [[planet]] [[Varkana]]. He was secretly a contact for the [[First Order]], who moved their shipments and materials through [[black market]] channels. He reported the [[Resistance]] [[spy]] [[Norath Kev]] to the [[bounty hunter]] [[Ax Tagrin]] when he found out who Kev really was.<ref name="The Missing Agent" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lechee first appeared in "[[The Missing Agent]]," a [[2019]] episode of the television show ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', voiced by [[Fred Armisen]].<ref name="The Missing Agent" /> He was named after [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Leland Chee]], who also provided a temporary recording of the character's dialogue.<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-the-missing-agent-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 6 Fun Facts from "The Missing Agent" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}}</ref>
